items.html: Strengths: Very experienced at the regional level. Played ``A'' team cricket too. Good technique in defence. Can open the batting but prefers the middle order for his aggressive styles. Has captained Leeward Islands so has the experiences of the game in his mind. Has been very productive this season, at the top of the regional averages. Has rebounded well after a very lack-lustre 1996-7. Was earmarked for Test cricket for some time. While still in his mid 20's, he has been around a long time.

Weaknesses: Does not always try to build innings. Sometime too agressive. Also too sullen. Needs to get into shape, both body and mind, for international cricket. Needs to bat for very long periods. (Colin Croft, March 1999)
